The two initiators are highly pleased and looking forward to participation in exciting projects. 21 universities are actively engaged in the network. network.stated_total_quote: One of the largest university cooperations worldwide, the Baltic University Programme (BUP) covers approximately 90 universities including 13 medical schools and numerous other university departments whose work focuses on Medical Technologies, Public Health, Health and Society.
